title: Suggested AGUI Harness application protocol v1; not official AG-UI wire format
description: Opt-in application-layer shape definitions. They do not authenticate identity, authorize access, enforce current versions/expiry, verify hashes or receipts, or implement atomic commits. Compose domain schemas and test service/database semantics.
$comment: All protocol objects are closed. Only DomainPayload is intentionally open. UTC epoch milliseconds explicitly encode server timestamps. A schema-valid rejected/revoked/expired/unknown record is not an instruction to execute it.

EpochMilliseconds.description: UTC Unix epoch milliseconds, integer within JavaScript safe range. This is the explicit UTC/time-zone representation used by this suggested wire schema. Ordering against now or another timestamp is a service check.

MoneyMinorUnits.description: Optional money representation; e.g. 12345 USD with exponent 2 means USD 123.45. The service validates actual currency/exponent, signs, rounding, range and overflow. Never use binary float for monetary invariants.

DomainPayload.description: Intentionally open domain data, not a validated business payload. MUST be validated against the referenced application/domain schema and service semantics before use. No credentials or authority claims may be trusted from this object.

policy_version.description: Authority-assigned integer version or opaque ETag; not a timestamp or permission.

TrustedContext.description: Host-created context after authentication/authorization. Successful JSON validation NEVER turns model/browser claims into trusted identity. Do not include bearer credentials in this model.

version.description: Authority-assigned integer version or opaque ETag; not a timestamp or permission.

EntityRef.description: Scoped entity reference; created_at is reference creation time, not necessarily entity birth. Version and authority refer to the system of record. Display labels are never write identifiers.

source_version.description: Authority-assigned integer version or opaque ETag; not a timestamp or permission.

content_hash.description: Digest of the application-defined canonical execution content. Shape validation does not recompute or authenticate this hash.

Evidence.description: Read evidence or a explicitly classified user statement/inference. Provenance does not grant permissions; freshness, authority and tenant linkage must be verified by the service.

policy_version.description: Authority-assigned integer version or opaque ETag; not a timestamp or permission.

Intent.description: Original user source plus parsed intent. The host resolves authorization_scope; model confidence, a resource ID, or a valid shape cannot authorize a write.

version.description: Authority-assigned integer version or opaque ETag; not a timestamp or permission.

proposal_hash.description: Digest of the application-defined canonical execution content. Shape validation does not recompute or authenticate this hash.

policy_version.description: Authority-assigned integer version or opaque ETag; not a timestamp or permission.

Proposal.description: Immutable reviewable candidate. Hash policy must cover the normalized execution payload and relevant scope, versions, recipients, money and expiry. Hash recomputation, freshness and conditional writes are service responsibilities.

proposal_hash.description: Digest of the application-defined canonical execution content. Shape validation does not recompute or authenticate this hash.

policy_version.description: Authority-assigned integer version or opaque ETag; not a timestamp or permission.

Approval.description: Host/approval-service decision bound to exact proposal hash. Authority, current permissions, revocation and time validity must be checked again at apply. A rejected/revoked record is not an execution permission.

payload_hash.description: Digest of the application-defined canonical execution content. Shape validation does not recompute or authenticate this hash.

Operation.description: Durable logical operation, separate from network attempts. Service/database enforce tenant+key uniqueness, payload matching, authorization before replay, and legal transitions. unknown cannot carry a success receipt.

payload_hash.description: Digest of the application-defined canonical execution content. Shape validation does not recompute or authenticate this hash.

version.description: Authority-assigned integer version or opaque ETag; not a timestamp or permission.

Receipt.description: Authority-issued durable result. unknown is deliberately not a receipt outcome. Existence, issuance, linkage and atomicity cannot be established by schema. Compensation is a new operation/receipt preserving the original fact.

UIEvent.description: Suggested application envelope, NOT official AG-UI wire fields. A validated final render is not automatically a business commit. Reducer/host verify ordering, revision, trusted receipt and source of truth.

MemoryFact.description: Subject/tenant-scoped memory with human edit revision and deletion tombstone. Atomic revision+purge-generation checks protect human corrections/deletes from in-flight extraction. Permissions, permitted categories, retention and tombstone lifetime are service policies.
